item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
Issued at 05:15 AM 15 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Iloilo(BarotacNuevo), #NegrosOccidental(CityOfSipalay, SilayCity, EnriqueB.Magalona, CityOfVictorias, CityOfTalisay), #NegrosOriental(CityOfBayawan and Basay) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Iloilo(Dumangas), #NegrosOccidental(Pulupandan) and #Guimaras(SanLorenzo) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
